Triage (first-touch grading): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`, `domain:ui` + bug, type Bug. Rationale: measured user-visible defect on a console-reachable path (`CreateViewDialog` offers `chart` and `gantt`; both render iconless while every sibling has an icon), with the root cause isolated to lucide dropping the old spellings from the `icons` record while keeping deprecated named exports — which is also why the compiler stays green and why no gate caught the bump. The icon-name choice is dev judgment (pick from the card's candidate table together with the adjacent `DEFAULT_VIEW_ICONS` entries); the load-bearing half of the fix is the resolvability pin widened to every name the map supplies, which #5321 deliberately scoped to `tree` alone so the widening could land here — that pin closes the class against the next lucide bump.

Dispatch notes: same file surface as in-flight #5321 (`packages/plugin-view/src/**`, same `iconMap`) — hard serial after #5321 lands; fold-or-serial answer owed by the dispatching seat if #5321 is still open at claim time. Size/model suggestion: S–M.

Icon selection comes from the card's own verified-resolving candidates.
